description: This file contains unit tests for the MembershipAgent class and related components within the Orleans testing framework. It verifies the lifecycle stages, connectivity validation, and IAmAlive update mechanisms of the membership agent using the xUnit testing framework.

classes.name: MembershipAgentTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the MembershipAgent class, focusing on lifecycle management, connectivity validation, and periodic updates within the Orleans membership system.

methods.name: MembershipAgent_LifecycleStages_GracefulShutdown
methods.description: Tests that the membership agent transitions through the correct shutdown states during a graceful shutdown sequence.

methods.name: MembershipAgent_LifecycleStages_UngracefulShutdown
methods.description: Verifies that the membership agent handles an ungraceful (cancellation) shutdown properly, transitioning states accordingly.

methods.name: MembershipAgent_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Ensures the IAmAlive update process functions correctly, including periodic timer invocations and error handling.

methods.name: MembershipAgent_LifecycleStages_ValidateInitialConnectivity_Success
methods.description: Verifies that the membership agent successfully confirms connectivity with other silos when they are active.

methods.name: MembershipAgent_LifecycleStages_ValidateInitialConnectivity_Failure
methods.description: Checks that the membership agent correctly handles failures when attempting to validate connectivity with other silos.

methods.name: StopLifecycle
methods.description: Helper method to stop the lifecycle and complete any ongoing timers or tasks.

methods.name: Until
methods.description: Utility method to wait until a condition becomes true or a timeout occurs, used for synchronization in tests.

methods.name: Silo
methods.description: Helper method to create a SiloAddress object from a string representation.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Helper method to create a MembershipEntry with specified address and status.
